title: Domain Email Finder by Scalelist
description: Provide a list of domains to search. You are charged per email found.

domains.title: Domain List
domains.description: List of domains to search. Each entry requires a domain, with optional company_name and limit (default: 10).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The company domain to search, e.g. acmecorp.com (required)

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: Company name — optional, helps improve matching accuracy

limit.title: Email Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return for this domain. Defaults to 10.
